basics.name: Karthik Kannan
basics.label: Aerospace Engineer | Flight Controls, Integration & Test
basics.summary: Ambitious aerospace engineer who enjoys tackling difficult problems, learning unfamiliar systems, and taking ideas from concept to working hardware. Motivated by challenging work that demands creativity, persistence, and technical ownership. Passionate about aerospace and robotics, with a hands-on approach to building, testing, and improving systems.

work.name: Boeing
work.summary: 777X Primary Flight Function testing and verification
highlights: Verify 777X Primary Flight Function (PFF) requirements through hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), software-in-the-loop (SIL), and on-aircraft testing using the Integrated Test Vehicle (ITV) and Psim simulation model.
Develop Psim aircraft scenarios and a custom Python parser, reproducing simulated conditions on ITV live hydraulic hardware; export test data to MATLAB for analysis and reporting.

Develop Python tools and structured reporting templates for global engineering teams, standardizing test documentation and guiding completion of information for Boeing PFF and FAA certification reviews.
Built a Python onboarding assistant using a local LLM to help PFF contractors find getting-started guidance in the team wiki.
Trace upstream and downstream signals in Simulink models to identify requirement-verification evidence, investigate discrepancies, and support corrections to test cases and documentation.
Contribute across PFF safety analysis, requirements, and test activities; collaborate with the FAA and engineering stakeholders to support Boeing 777-9 certification.

work.name: Mach Industries
work.summary: UAS development, ground testing, and flight test
highlights: Planned and led selected flight tests for a UAS developed from concept to first flight in three months, defining flight plans, coordinating execution, and documenting discrepancies and lessons learned.
Designed and operated propulsion and avionics ground test infrastructure, including engine test stands, hot-fire and thermal-soak testing, thrust measurements, and vibration characterization.

Supported testing of aircraft communications, onboard video streaming, and accelerometer data streams used in GPS-denied navigation development; performed post-test data reduction and root cause analysis.

Delivered technical and product briefings to senior government officials, military leaders, and international delegations, adapting engineering information to varied audiences. Interviewed prospective engineers.

work.name: Collier Aerospace
work.summary: Aerospace structural analysis and Python automation
highlights: Analyzed and sized composite and metallic aerospace structures using HyperX, performing trade studies and delivering technical reports for customers including NASA, Electra, ULA, Blue Origin, and Boeing.
Performed finite element analysis (FEA) in FEMAP and NASTRAN to evaluate load paths, stress distributions, and potential failure modes in aerospace components.

Developed Python automation tools and plug-ins implementing structural mechanics methods to assess aircraft-specific spar cutout sizes and shapes, structural performance, and weight-reduction trade studies.
Supported environmental loads analysis and high-temperature composites research, preparing structural trade studies and technical documentation tailored to customer-specific requirements.

work.name: Teaching Assistant – NC State University
work.summary: Supported aerospace courses including Intro to Aerospace, Structures, and Applied Aerodynamics.
highlights: Assisted over 150 students through labs, grading, and structured review sessions.
Led demos on aerodynamic flow visualization and structural testing.
Collaborated with professors on curriculum design and assessments.
Maintained a high-energy teaching style recognized by students and faculty.

work.name: Four Colors Tech
work.summary: Worked at early-stage AI startup on proprietary LLM-powered enterprise assistant (COG).
highlights: Optimized large language models for PLM and CAD data environments.
Fine-tuned NLP models for classification, summarization, and revision tracking.
Built self-healing automation systems for enterprise workflows.
Streamlined automation pipelines with Playwright and Selenium, cutting QA time by 40%.
Secured training datasets using masking and anonymization strategies.
Supported NX CAD optimization workflows and PLM standardization strategies.

work.name: Undead Electronics
work.summary: Repaired and serviced electronics in a fast-paced repair environment.
highlights: Diagnosed and repaired 100+ devices including phones, laptops, and tablets.
Performed micro-soldering and IC replacement for motherboard repair.
Recovered and migrated customer data from damaged devices.
Maintained repair documentation and improved shop intake workflows.

work.name: Zaloni
work.summary: Developed automation solutions for healthcare data pipelines at enterprise data company.
highlights: Built automated pipelines to catalog DICOM medical images and records.
Developed parsers in Java/Python to integrate metadata into SQL Server.
Deployed a production system at Duke Hospitals saving $100,000 annually.
Improved fault tolerance and batch-processing speed for clinical data ingestion.

publications.name: Innovative Drone Systems for Disaster Response
publications.summary: Published paper detailing the design and validation of an autonomous drone system for natural disaster response, integrating power line charging, YOLOv8-based vision, and swarm intelligence for urban deployment.

projects.name: REACHR | Controls, Avionics and Structures Team Lead | 2024–2025
projects.summary: Led a five-member team in structures, controls, and avionics for a FEMA-backed amphibious UAV awarded $80,000. Adapted real-time human detection and landing-site selection to process aircraft streams on a ground computer due to onboard compute/storage limits. Supported system architecture and flight controls; prepared SWOT analysis for SBIR proposals.

projects.name: GoAERO | Structures and AI/ML Team Lead | 2024–2025
projects.summary: Led a seven-member team in structural design and AI/ML integration, including object detection, for a rescue UAV; served as team spokesperson. The team received ~$70,000 during tenure.

projects.name: Poseidon UAV | Senior Design Project Manager | 2023–2024
projects.summary: Led avionics, payload integration, and structural analysis for a NASA Blue Skies disaster-response UAV. Developed computer vision for landing-site selection and aerial human detection, evaluated using recorded imagery and video; authored an AIAA paper on disaster-response drone concepts.

projects.name: Materials Research | NC State University | 2022
projects.summary: Developed a MATLAB/Python neural network under Dr. Cheryl Xu to predict composite return loss and explore ceramic compositions; transferred the model to an industry collaborator for training on a larger dataset. Received a $4,000 research grant.
